reviews.text: As always the food was brilliant! Highly recommend the black garlic tonkatsu! Unfortunately the floor and the stairs were so slippery it was like an ice rink. It was a massive health and safety hazard. I almost fell several times coming down from the bathrooms despite clinging to the hand rails. It was like there was a layer of oil across the floor that got worse the closer you go to the kitchen or upstairs. The toilets were also in desperate need of a good deep clean, limescale removal and the floor scrubbing as it was dirty. Was suprised it got a 5* hygiene rating so recently with these issues. Hope they're fixed quickly as I love to eat here and would really worry about going back and falling. Unfortunately the staff seemed stressed, but I would be too trying to not spill food and drinks on a floor that slippery. I hope the management invest in a deep clean to fix the oily issues and the bathrooms.

reviews.author: Sundus
reviews.text: Decided to pop in here for a late lunch with my family. We were stood waiting for a good while to be seated. When we did eventually get seated, it took about ten minutes to get the waiter and waitresses attention. There were only three members of staff serving the whole restaurant which was quite full. We placed our order with one of our mains and one starter arriving within about 15 minutes. We then waited around 20 minutes patiently wondering where the rest of our meal was - we were a table of five and had ordered four dishes to share. We reminded the staff about our order and it seemed they had forgotten or misplaced the order? Another ten mins or so later our food was brought out. We weren’t once asked if the food was ok. Service was extremely slow. Our meal came to £64 for what felt like a really weird and disjointed meal. The service charge was cancelled upon our request but tbh I wouldn’t eat there again. The food was very much overpriced and overrated. When the remainder of our food finally arrived it wasn’t even very hot, and the noodles tastes bland. The whole plate looked like it had been made in a rush. Furthermore, the floor was extremely slippery throughout and with other customers slipping on the stairs to the toilets. A member of staff actually slipped too and several children and other customers were scared to used the stairs for fear of also slipping. A hugely disappointing experience. I will never eat here again.

reviews.author: Cee
reviews.text: We visited Maki & Ramen in meadowhall at around 1 pm on 25 October 2026, and I wanted to leave a special mention for a young blonde waitress wearing a kimono. Unfortunately, I didn’t get her name, but I really hope management knows who she is and recognises what a fantastic job she was doing. She was absolutely lovely! Despite what was clearly a stressful situation, she remained, polite, friendly and welcoming throughout. She had such a lovely, happy face and a genuinely warm attitude, even when things were obviously difficult. Her hard work and work ethic really stood out to us, and I hope she knows that these qualities will take her far in life. Please keep it up! However, I do feel it is important to highlight the staffing situation. There appeared to be only three waiting staff while all the tables were full, which simply didn’t seem enough to manage the restaurant effectively. We had to get the waitress’s attention to place our order, and we witnessed another table complaining and speaking quite rudely to her, despite the lack of staff clearly not being her fault. It was a shame to see someone who was trying so hard to do her job being put in that position. The staff deserve enough support to be able to do their jobs properly, especially during busy periods. Our previous experience at this branch wasn’t particularly great, as we were served by someone who was quite rude, which had put us off returning a little. However, this visit has completely changed that impression, and we will definitely be coming back! A huge well done to her — she was a real credit to the restaurant.

reviews.author: Luca Cabrini
reviews.text: I ordered the "spicy seafood ramen." I knew it would be spicy, but I certainly did not expect the noodles to taste like supermarket instant noodles rather than fresh ones. The salmon was dry, and the other piece of fish was chewy and rubbery and dish itself smell like old food. Even though I left my dish almost untouched, no one from the staff checked on us or asked if everything was okay. On top of that, the staff were extremely loud. While we were still eating, they started emptying bins and left bags of rubbish behind our table because they were getting ready to close. It was very noisy and showed little consideration for customers who were still dining. This was my fourth visit. The first two times were shortly after they opened, and I have to say the quality has dropped significantly since then. When it was time to pay, the manager asked if I wanted to take the food home. After I explained that I hadn't enjoyed the meal, her only response was, "Oh, okay, sorry," before walking away. Honestly, I wasn't expecting a discount or for the dish to be removed from the bill. I simply expected a bit more care and attention towards the customer. I truly believe this will be my last visit here (even though you'll probably think, "Okay, no problem"). It's disappointing to see how much things have changed.

So in the end the server gave us free drinks, but i still think we should be happy and satisfy with our service. And we are not! I have many restaurants myself and this is not the right way to run a business. So my conclusion, seeing the servers running on but ignoring customers is a pity, the restaurant owner should hire more staff, they have only three but it’s a big restaurant, and the servers is also the bartender? reviews.text: Seems an ongoing issue but all noodles and some other bits were out of stock. Unsure why but looking at other reviews it seems this is normal for them. Food was okay, nothing to write home about. Gyozas were nice. Food came before our drinks which was odd.

reviews.author: Shaz R.
reviews.text: I really don’t want this to come across as complaining, as I understand that not everything was within Maki Ramen’s control, especially as I ordered through Slerp. However, the back and forth between Slerp and Maki Ramen while trying to cancel the order was exhausting, particularly after being told I couldn’t cancel. We’ve just moved in and currently don’t have a kitchen or microwave, so waiting over an hour only to receive cold food was really upsetting, especially as I was starving. In the end, we couldn’t even eat the food, which was really disappointing given the circumstances. I appreciated receiving a full refund, and I was also grateful that a goodwill gesture was offered for the inconvenience by Chris the assistant manager, although I haven’t received any further update on this. I’m not trying to be difficult or unappreciative, and I do understand that things can go wrong. I was just really disappointed because, after such a stressful move and currently not having a kitchen or microwave, the experience was much harder than it needed to be. Ultimately, we were left unable to eat our food after waiting over an hour, and although the refund was appreciated, it didn’t change how disappointing the overall experience was.

reviews.text: Fantastic experience walking in, the wonderful Ginger took us to the sushi bar seats and treated us very well - and promptly, which was very much appreciated because we were on our way to see The Mousetrap!
